% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % (a) tadpole x tadpole-free figure-eight
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(2,0); \draw[fdl] (1,0.36) circle (0.36);
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2,0){$y$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (1,-0.05){$z_v$};
    \draw[fdl] (3.0,0.6) circle (0.3); \draw[fdl] (3.0,0.0) circle (0.3); \node[fdv] at (3.0,0.3){};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (3.32,0.3){$z_w$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.6,-1.25) {(a) $C_1V_1$: $72$ contractions,\\[1pt] $\frac{72}{1152}=\frac1{16}=\frac12\cdot\frac18$, $S=2\cdot8$};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) free line times the second-order bubbles
  \newcommand{\lineunder}[1]{\draw[fdl] (#1-0.15,-0.75)--(#1+1.95,-0.75); \node[fdx] at (#1-0.15,-0.75){}; \node[fdx] at (#1+1.95,-0.75){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (#1-0.15,-0.75){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (#1+1.95,-0.75){$y$};}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=5.2cm, yshift=0.35cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0.25,0) to[bend left=35] (1.55,0); \draw[fdl] (0.25,0) to[bend right=35] (1.55,0);
    \draw[fdl] (-0.05,0) circle (0.3); \draw[fdl] (1.85,0) circle (0.3);
    \node[fdv] at (0.25,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.55,0){};
    \lineunder{0}
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.9,-1.6) {dumbbell: $72$, $\frac1{16}$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=8.4cm, yshift=0.35cm]
    \foreach \b in {70,22,-22,-70}{\draw[fdl] (0.1,0) to[bend left=\b] (1.7,0);}
    \node[fdv] at (0.1,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.7,0){};
    \lineunder{0}
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.9,-1.6) {melon: $24$, $\frac1{48}$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=12.0cm, yshift=0.35cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0.3,0.25) circle (0.25); \draw[fdl] (0.3,-0.25) circle (0.25); \node[fdv] at (0.3,0){};
    \draw[fdl] (1.5,0.25) circle (0.25); \draw[fdl] (1.5,-0.25) circle (0.25); \node[fdv] at (1.5,0){};
    \lineunder{0}
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.9,-1.6) {two eights: $9$, $\frac1{128}$};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS] at (9.95,-2.25) {(b) $D_F(x-y)\,V_2$: $\hat\phi_x$--$\hat\phi_y$ contracted, the eight legs paired in $105=72+24+9$ ways};
